items.name: Chinese Tea Dataset
items.summary: A curated, open dataset of 100+ Chinese teas covering type, origin, caffeine level, flavor notes, oxidation, processing method, and brewing parameters. Available as JSON and CSV.

items.name: Furrow Farmland Price Index
items.summary: Agricultural land prices in 37 countries, each from that country's own statistical office, converted to one currency at a single European Central Bank reference rate and ranked. Every row carries its basis, year and source, because the figures are not strictly comparable.

items.name: The global dataset of historical yields for major crops 1981–2016
items.summary: The Global Dataset of Historical Yield (GDHYv1.2+v1.3) offers annual time series data of 0.5-degree grid-cell yield estimates of major crops worldwide for the period 1981-2016. The crops considered in this dataset are maize, rice, wheat and soybean. The unit of yield data is t/ha.

items.name: Hyperspectral benchmark dataset on soil moisture
items.summary: This dataset was measured in a five-day field campaign in May 2017 in Karlsruhe, Germany. An undisturbed soil sample is the centerpiece of the measurement setup. The soil sample consists of bare soil without any vegetation and was taken in the area near Waldbronn, Germany.
